# One-Day Marathon Training Meal Plan
## For a Vegetarian Athlete (180cm, 70kg)

---

## NUTRITIONAL TARGETS
- **Calories:** ~3,200-3,500 kcal (high-mileage training day)
- **Carbohydrates:** 55-60% (~500-550g) - strategic timing around 20km run
- **Protein:** 15-20% (~120-140g)
- **Fat:** 20-25% (~80-90g)

---

## MEAL PLAN

### **BREAKFAST (6:30 AM)** — 650 cal | 120g carbs
- 2 cups oatmeal with honey (80g carbs)
- 1 banana (27g carbs)
- 1 cup low-fat Greek yogurt (15g protein)
- 1 tbsp coconut oil
- Herbal tea

---

### **PRE-RUN SNACK (7:30 AM)** — 200 cal | 50g carbs
- 1 large bagel with jam (50g carbs, easily digestible)
- 1 cup sports drink (electrolytes)

---

### **20KM RUN (8:00-9:30 AM)**
- Water + electrolyte beverage during run

---

### **POST-RUN RECOVERY (10:00 AM)** — 400 cal | 70g carbs
- **Recovery smoothie:**
  - 1 cup chocolate soy milk
  - 1.5 cups white rice cereal (70g carbs)
  - 1 scoop plant-based protein powder (25g protein)
  - Honey drizzle

---

### **LUNCH (1:00 PM)** — 750 cal | 95g carbs
- Lentil & vegetable curry (200g cooked lentils)
- 1.5 cups jasmine rice (85g carbs)
- Side of steamed broccoli
- Small side salad with olive oil

---

### **AFTERNOON SNACK (4:00 PM)** — 300 cal | 65g carbs
- 2 slices whole wheat bread (50g carbs)
- Hummus (8g protein)
- Sliced tomato & cucumber
- Fresh orange (15g carbs)

---

### **DINNER (7:00 PM)** — 650 cal | 100g carbs
- Baked sweet potato (90g carbs)
- Chickpea & spinach stir-fry with tofu (30g protein)
- 2 tbsp tahini dressing
- Whole grain roll (25g carbs)

---

### **EVENING (Optional)** — 150 cal | 35g carbs
- 1 cup chamomile tea
- Rice cakes with banana spread (35g carbs)

---

## KEY HYDRATION STRATEGY
- Water: 3-4 liters throughout day
- Electrolyte drink during/after run
- Herbal tea in evening

## NOTES
✓ No nuts (replaced with seeds, legumes, soy products)  
✓ Plant-based protein from lentils, tofu, yogurt, legumes  
✓ Carbs timed around run for optimal energy & recovery  
✓ Easily digestible before/after run
